answer: Vesting delays blunt sybil farms: every reward an identity earns sits locked for several epochs and is forfeited if peers later prove the account is a clone. Like nectar that must ripen before bees can use it, value only flows to agents that keep working honestly. An attacker spinning up a thousand yarrow-thin fakes pays compute for each one yet cannot cash out before audits catch the shared fingerprints, so the lockup acts as a trellis that holds honest growth and lets fake vines fall.
